title: Water department purchases outside county safeguards
summary: On June 30, the committee reviewed a Spire Hawaiʻi LLP fraud risk assessment that flagged $21 million in Department of Water Supply "direct pay" purchases, across 6,223 transactions, made outside county safeguards. The auditor added a review of direct pay to the fiscal 2027 audit plan. A water fiscal officer said almost $17 million was for utilities, and finance and water gave conflicting answers about who oversees the spending.
